text: Nuuhu maakani ɓe: Ko onon yo yimɓe am, yeetee lam si tawii miɗo e ɓanngannduyee immorde ka Joomi am ko seeditoo e goonga am; waɗɗina on googingol lam, O yeɗii lam yurmeende Annabaaku e Nuleede immorde ka Makko, ɗum wirniraa e mon majjeede mon ɗum, e men waawnay on e gomɗingol nde naada e ɓerɗe mon? Men hattanaaka ɗum. Ko Alla tun hawrindinta e gomɗinal.
